content: MDN: Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER = 2^53-1 = 9007199254740991. Beyond it, IEEE-754 doubles cannot represent every integer; MAX_SAFE_INTEGER+1 === MAX_SAFE_INTEGER+2 evaluates true. JSON.parse in JS turns 64-bit int literals into lossy doubles. Twitter/X therefore ships id_str alongside id; Snowflake values (e.g. 1888944671579078978) vastly exceed 2^53 so APIs must serialize IDs as strings.
